svg.title: whoami — terminal
svg.desc: Terminal card. whoami: Rishikesh Kallapally, EIE undergrad at NIT Silchar, class of 2027; builds backends and full-stack apps and writes firmware on the side. Stack: backend Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security with JWT, JPA, Flyway; frontend React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Vitest; data and AI PostgreSQL with pgvector, MySQL, Redis, Spring AI, RAG, PyTorch; embedded C, Thumb-2 assembly, Cortex-M4 STM32F4, CMSIS-DSP. Now: placement-prep next adds company-wise AI mock interviews; product-catalog has 11 of 16 phases done, a React storefront is next; kestrel-rtos next measures real-board cycle counts; tiny-reasoner is done: a language model built from scratch, where reinforcement learning (GRPO) took level-5 accuracy from 52 to 96 percent; RL_PID beats the published agent and runs on an STM32F4; the interactive portfolio is live at rishitheb0t.github.io/portfolio.
